description: This file defines the gitlabrestInterface class which extends issueTrackerInterface, providing integration with GitLab API for issue tracking purposes. It includes methods for connecting to GitLab, retrieving issues, adding issues and notes, and managing configuration settings.

classes.name: gitlabrestInterface
classes.description: A class providing integration with GitLab issue tracking via REST API, enabling issue retrieval, creation, and comment adding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, setting up configuration, default statuses, and establishing a connection to GitLab.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration setup by processing attributes and custom fields, establishing default issue attributes.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the internal API client object for direct API interactions.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the provided bug ID string has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to GitLab using configuration parameters.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to GitLab is active.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Generates the URL to view a specific issue in GitLab.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about an issue from GitLab.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code of a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Provides a verbose status string for a specific issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string of the issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether an issue with the given ID exists in GitLab.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in GitLab with provided summary and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a comment/note to an existing GitLab issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration snippet for the GitLab issue tracker integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via API (returns true).
